messages:
sophia_cs: Heads-up — on renewal watchlist: Acme Health (Acct 1729) showing high latency and cost spike. I drafted a short customer-runbook for caching/prefetch/batching we can share during next enablement. Sharing here for feedback.

mike_se: Nice, drop it in. Key ask from AMs will be quick wins we can show in 48h.

sophia_cs: Paste runbook below — TL;DR: (1) prefetch prefixes for common prompts, (2) enable lightweight KV cache with TTL 24h for static context, (3) set batching window 25ms for chat paths, (4) enable streaming fallback for long responses.

anya_se: quick config snippet for KV cache:
```
cache:
  type: kv
  provider: redis
  ttl_seconds: 86400
  key_strategy: prompt_hash_v1
  prefetch_keys: ["onboarding-steps","product-faq"]
```

sam_product: Also add a short A/B test plan — measure tokens/latency/cost change and NPS before/after.

sophia_cs: proposed rollout checklist to share with customer:
- quick telemetry snapshot
- apply prefetch rules at edge
- monitor 24/48h
- revert/adjust batching if error rate > 0.5%

mike_se: For batching, recommend:
```
batching:
  mode: dynamic
  max_batch_tokens: 2048
  batching_delay_ms: 25
  priority_routes: ["chat-short","autocomplete"]
```

jordan_am: I'll ask Acme's engineering lead if we can toggle prefetch for a small subset of traffic first. They care about cost but also about hallucination risk — can prefetch increase stale responses?

sophia_cs: Good Q. Prefetch only for stable prompts (docs/FAQ) — include prompt versioning in keys. If model output changes we increment the version in key.

anya_se: streaming fallback: set stream_timeout=3000ms; if stream stalls, fall back to non-stream with small batch to finish tokens.

sophia_cs: Final ask: can eng create a one-click JSON we can pass to customers' SREs? Something like `runbook-v1.json` with the above configs and a monitoring query. @anya_se can you produce by EOD?

anya_se: Yep, will push a gist and attach to the customer doc. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Runbook gist created: https://gist.github.com/redwood/runbook-1803004567

sophia_cs: Thanks team — I'll sync with jordan_am and schedule a 30-min enablement with Acme this week. Tagging renewal playbook. :rocket:
